description: This file defines the RateReadService interface used for retrieving rate data within the Fineract project. It declares methods for fetching all rates, loan applicable rates, specific rate by ID or name, and rates associated with specific loans or products.

classes.name: RateReadService
classes.description: Interface for reading rate data, providing methods to retrieve various rate details from the data source.

methods.name: retrieveAllRates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all rate data available.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rate data by its unique identifier.

methods.name: retrieveByName
methods.description: Retrieves rate data by its name.

methods.name: retrieveProductLoanRates
methods.description: Retrieves rate data associated with a specific loan product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanRates
methods.description: Retrieves rate data associated with a specific loan.
